title: Third Floor rate series
description: One FRED series, whole, at data/_rates/<SERIES>.json (3F D-23). CPIAUCNS is consumer prices, not seasonally adjusted, monthly; DGS3MO is the three-month Treasury yield in percent a year, daily. A run may add observations and may never change one already published: neither series is revised by its publisher, and the ingest refuses a change.

missing_days_dropped.description: Days FRED lists with no reading ('.'), counted and left out rather than read as zero. October 2025's consumer prices were never collected.
